file.notApplied: The settings file on disk is not applied

auth.accountDetail: Your name, password and second factors.
auth.membersDetail: Who uses Expenses, and their role: members send their own claims and approve what names them, viewers see every claim and the reports, editors are finance and pay claims back, admins also manage members and tokens.
auth.signinDetail: How people sign in: passwords, and identity providers with OIDC.
auth.tokensDetail: Tokens for scripts and other products, each with a role and an end date. Payroll needs one with the editor role, Time one with the viewer role.
auth.financeOnlyDetail: Every claim, paying back and the reports are for members with the viewer role or higher.

claims.newDetail: A claim is your expenses sent together, such as one trip or one month's taxis. Add receipts to it next.
claims.title: Title

mine.title: My claims
mine.description: Photograph a receipt and it is read into the claim. Send the claim when it is complete; your manager approves it first.
mine.none: No claims yet. Start one with New claim.
mine.noEmailDetail: Claims are sent by people; API tokens read and pay them but send none.
mine.ibanDetail: Claims paid by bank transfer go to this account. It is shown masked; only finance's transfer list holds it in full.
mine.ibanSet: Paid back by transfer to {{iban}}, or with your pay when finance puts the claim in a payroll batch.
mine.ibanUnset: No IBAN yet: claims are paid back with your pay, or finance asks you for one.

approve.title: To approve
approve.description: Claims of the people you manage, and steps the policy gives you. Finance steps go to any member with the editor role who has not approved the claim already.
approve.noneDecided: You have not decided a claim yet.

all.title: All claims
all.description: Every sent claim, for viewers and finance. Drafts stay with their owner.

claim.notFound: No such claim, or it is not yours to see
claim.withdrawn: Taken back: it is a draft again, and nobody is asked until it is sent.
claim.blocked: This claim cannot be sent yet
claim.noItems: No items yet. Add a receipt, a trip by car or days away.
claim.whoApprovesDraft: From expenses.yaml, for this total; nobody approves their own claim.
claim.notMember: {{email}} is not a member of Expenses yet: finance passes the step on, or an admin adds them.
claim.noSteps: Nobody yet: the steps are set when the claim is sent.
claim.approvedStep: Approved your step. {{next}} takes the next one; {{name}} sees where it is.
claim.approvedAll: Approved. {{amount}} waits for the next pay-back batch.
claim.approvedCard: Approved. The company card paid it all, so nothing is paid back.
claim.rejectDetail: It cannot be sent again. To have something changed, send it back instead.
claim.sendBackDetail: It goes back as a draft; they change it and send it again.
claim.passTitle: Pass the step to someone else
claim.passDetail: For a manager who is away or not a member here. The step now with {{step}} goes to the member you name.

item.receiptDetail: A photo or a PDF ({{types}}, up to {{size}}). Its metadata, such as where it was taken, is removed when it is kept.
item.mileageDetail: Your own car, at {{rate}} a km as expenses.yaml sets it.
item.daysDetail: A daily allowance by country, counted in half days.
item.photo: Pick the photo or PDF; you type in what it says.
item.photoRead: Pick the photo or PDF; its amount, date and seller are read for you.
item.readNone: Type in what the receipt says.
item.readUnclear: The receipt could not be read clearly; type in what it says.
item.readFailed: The receipt reader did not answer; type in what it says.
item.readConfidence: Read with {{percent}}% confidence; check it, and type in anything unclear.
item.readCheck: Check what was read, and type in anything unclear.
item.usedBefore: This file is on another item already; finance will be asked.
item.documentAuto: As the file and currency say
item.taxNumberHint: VKN (10 digits) or TCKN (11), as printed
item.noReceiptHint: Without a receipt, finance approves the claim too.
item.daysHint: In half days: 1.5 is a day and a half.
item.kmInvalid: Kilometres are a number above 0, with at most one decimal.
item.daysInvalid: Days away are a number above 0, in half days: 1, 1.5, 2.
item.amountInvalid: The total is an amount, such as 640 or 640,50.

over.flag: More than this is flagged, and finance approves it too.
over.block: More than this stops the claim from being sent.
over.cap: More than this is not paid back: you get the limit.

cards.title: Company cards
cards.description: Purchases from the bank's card statement, given to their holder by the card's last four digits. A receipt with the same amount within {{days}} days is matched to it; the rest wait for a receipt.
cards.importDetail: The bank's CSV. It is checked first; purchases already imported are left out.
cards.withoutHolder_one: {{count}} on a card with no holder in expenses.yaml
cards.withoutHolder_other: {{count}} on cards with no holder in expenses.yaml
cards.skipped_one: {{count}} line that is not a purchase
cards.imported: Imported {{file}}: {{added}} new, {{duplicates}} already imported, {{matched}} matched to receipts. Holders are asked for the rest.

payback.title: Pay back
payback.description: Approved claims are paid back in batches: with pay, which Payroll takes for the month, or by bank transfer from a list you upload to the bank.
payback.allInBatch: Every approved claim is in a batch.
payback.newAll_one: With the {{count}} approved claim not in a batch.
payback.newAll_other: With all {{count}} approved claims not in a batch.
payback.removed: Removed {{number}}; its claims wait for another batch.
payback.sentPayroll: {{number}} is locked. Payroll adds {{amount}} to the pay of {{day}}, on each person's payslip.
payback.sentTransfer: {{number}} is locked. Download the transfer list and upload it to the bank for {{day}}.
payback.paidDetail: Every claim in it becomes paid back, and their owners see it.

spend.title: Spend
spend.description: Approved and paid-back spending in TL. Card purchases count once their receipt is on a claim.
spend.flagsDetail: Items over a limit, without a receipt, late or looking like a duplicate
spend.kdvDetail: By rate, from receipts and invoices; for the accountant to deduct

exports.title: Exports
exports.description: For your accountant: separated by {{separator}} with a decimal {{decimal}}, as expenses.yaml sets it.
exports.items: Every approved item: date, person, category and its account code, project, seller, tax number, KDV rate and amount, TL and the original currency.
exports.receipts: The month's receipt photos and PDFs, a folder per claim, named by item.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: What Expenses reads from other services, and what other products call. Links are set in expenses.yaml.
integrations.hr: People, their departments and managers, for who approves. Until it is linked, people: in expenses.yaml is used.
integrations.time: Projects that expenses are charged to. Until it is linked, projects: in expenses.yaml is used.
integrations.readerDetail: A service on your network that reads a receipt's amount, date and seller. Without it, people type them in.
integrations.tcmb: Exchange rates for receipts in other currencies, from TCMB's daily bulletin.
integrations.payroll: Payroll takes the payroll batches of a month and marks them paid.
integrations.projectCostsDetail: Time shows what was spent on each project.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Limits, rates, who approves, receipts and cards, as {{file}} sets them.
settings.readOnlyDetail: Change them in the file and review the change like code; Expenses reads it again within a minute. A file with a mistake leaves the last good version in place.
settings.noFile: No settings file: the defaults are in use.
settings.perKm: {{amount}} a km in your own car

rate.previous: TCMB rate of the business day before the receipt
rate.same: TCMB rate of the receipt's day

settings.approvalsDetail: Nobody approves their own claim, and the same person approves once.
settings.lateAfter: Older than {{days}} days brings finance in
settings.readerOn: Read, kept when at least {{percent}}% sure
settings.cardsValue_one: {{count}} card by its last four digits; receipts match within {{days}} days
settings.cardsValue_other: {{count}} cards by their last four digits; receipts match within {{days}} days
